title: 1v1 on turn

diagram.extractedFrom: hand-drawn SVG, generated from Jeff's description (not a PDF)

setup: Two goals facing same direction with line of players between them (attack/defense). Another line of players (with balls) 20yd away, facing the goals (passers).
instructions: Attacker starts 5yd ahead of the defender. Checks to the passer to get ball. Turns and tries to score on either goal.
Defender tries to take ball away and clear it.
Rotation: Attacker fetches the ball and goes to passing line. Passer goes to attack/defense line. Defender becomes attacker.
coachingPoints: Check to the passer to get the ball, then turn and try to score on either goal.
